name: black-braids-bed-bear
image_purpose: Bedroom lifestyle post and casual portrait

prompt.project_info: Create a photorealistic vertical bedroom portrait of an approved adult woman, preserving the braided pigtails, black beret, modest ribbed top, plaid skirt, teddy bear, and soft bedding.
prompt.main_subject: Approved adult woman with long straight black braided pigtails and dark eyes, wearing a black wool beret, black long-sleeve ribbed top with lace-trim neckline, and black-and-white plaid pleated skirt. Hold a black teddy bear and touch the cheek playfully with one index finger.
prompt.composition_elements: Eye-level shot from the foot of the bed, subject lying comfortably on her back with legs extending toward the camera and natural foreshortening, looking directly at the viewer with a soft smile. Include wooden headboard, crimson and cream pillows, rumpled red sheets. Vertical 4:5.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Soft natural window light with diffuse shadows, gentle realistic fabric texture, cozy bedroom atmosphere, clear but natural focus.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic DSLR-style portrait, vertical 4:5, eye-level foot-of-bed perspective, high detail, natural proportions and skin texture.
prompt.generated_prompt_string: Photorealistic vertical 4:5 portrait of an approved adult woman with long straight black braided pigtails and dark eyes, lying comfortably on her back on a bed. She wears a black wool beret, black long-sleeve ribbed top with lace-trim neckline, and black-and-white plaid pleated skirt, holds a black teddy bear, and touches her cheek with one index finger while looking at the viewer with a soft smile. Wooden headboard, crimson and cream pillows, rumpled red sheets, soft natural window light, diffuse shadows, cozy playful bedroom mood, eye-level view from the foot of the bed.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, sexualized pose, exposed intimate areas, minors, celebrity likeness, public figure likeness, drawing, anime, cartoon, 3D render, bad anatomy, deformed hands, missing fingers, extra limbs, blurry, low quality, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, watermark, text
